about: Raw measurements in image space. src/campus-data.js is generated from this file by scripts/build-campus-data.mjs; edit this file, not the generated one.

image.name: zoom-19 satellite mosaic (Esri World Imagery), 2304 x 2816 px, north up; not included in the repository

lean.range: 2.1 to 3.1 px per metre along the south component
lean.basis: The image is oblique, viewed from the north-north-east: roofs appear displaced toward the south-south-west of their bases and north facades are visible. Magnitude calibrated on the teaching slabs' visible north facade band (about 47 px) against an estimated 20.7 m height, so it inherits that height's uncertainty. Found by the east-slabs measurement agent; not independently calibrated.

assumptions.note: No building height has been measured. Every height is an estimate from storey counts or proportions in video footage.

track.standard: 400 m, 8 lanes: straights 84.39 m, inner bend radius 36.50 m, lane width 1.22 m; outer extent 176.91 x 92.52 m
track.basis: Infield grass measured on the satellite image (crisp edges): 71.4 x 109.3 m. Outer extent measured on near-vertical frames 79-81 of the 2022 sports-day video using the infield as scale: 177.2 x 92.2 m, within 0.3 m of a standard 400 m track, so standard geometry is used. Track centre is 1.1 m south and 0.4 m east of the infield centre in those frames. An earlier satellite-only reading (160 m long) was wrong: the south bend is under tree shadow and was also cut by the crop boundary.
features: retired fighter jet on display outside the south-west bend (2022 video frames 79-81)
long-jump runway with sand pits between the west straight and the stand
high-jump area in the south D

items.name: North teaching slab (east of plaza canopy)

height.basis: 5 storeys counted in the 2018 video x assumed 3.9 m floor height + 1.2 m parapet; estimate

items.measuredBy: measurement agent (east-slabs), single reading, recheck pending
items.notes: ROOF outline as it appears in the image, NOT a ground footprint: the image is oblique (taken from the NNE), the blue-grey gridded band at y 1098-1136/1146 is the north facade, not shadow and not roof. Ground footprint is roughly this outline moved about 47 px north and 5 px east (uncertain 40-60 px). Dark grey flat roof with white parapets and rooftop units; long white pipe/parapet lines at y 1157/1167 and 1176; lighter 9 px strip y 1176-1185 along the south side (corridor roof). North edge steps 10 px at x 1529 (west 68 px at y 1146, east part at y 1136); video suggests the west part is taller, so the step may be height rather than plan. Small block at SW corner x 1460-1489, y 1181-1203 included. South edge east of x 1575 is in shadow (inferred). Main bar 176 px long (48 m), 39-49 px deep. Video frame 5 shows about 5 window rows on the north facade (count +/-1). One of TWO slabs in this zone.

items.name: Clock tower (plan position, in the same roof-level frame as the south slab outline)

height.basis: top about twice the 5-storey slab height in frame 8 of the 2018 video; rough estimate, +/- 5 m

items.measuredBy: measurement agent (east-slabs), single reading, recheck pending
items.notes: Identified with moderate-to-good confidence, but NOT as a clean square in plan: because the image is oblique the tower shows as a leaning strip (see clock-tower-leaning-image) with its top displaced about 100 px SSW of its base. This rect is where the shaft sits relative to the south slab's roof outline as drawn (about 20 px = 5.5 m square, 19-39 px west of the slab's west end, level with the northern/central part of the slab's width), so it can be used directly next to the slab entries. True ground position is roughly centre (1413,1255) +/-12. The base is hidden behind the glass stair block. Rough height from video proportions (top is about 6 storey-heights above the slab roof): about 45 m, +/-5, an estimate not a measurement. Evidence: strip follows the lean direction of other vertical edges; sunlit white east-face sliver; teal shadow patch on the canopy's SE corner (x 1355-1390, y 1278-1310) pointing back to it; position matches frames 7-10 (west end of the south slab, glass block on its north side, canopy beyond).
items.leanNote: The measured square is the shaft's position expressed in the frame of the adjoining slab roof outline, so it is shifted by the slab roof height, not by the tower's own height.

items.name: Long east-west block A, north bar (called a dormitory by the measurement agent; use not established - its fascia carries a slogan in the 2018 video)

height.basis: 6 floor lines counted by the measurement agent on one block's north facade in the satellite image; 3.3 m floor height assumed; estimate, +/- 4 m

items.measuredBy: measurement agent (dorms), single reading, recheck pending
items.notes: Roof outline as seen: 349 x 43 px = 95.9 x 11.8 m, exactly east-west. Beige flat roof; band of rooftop structures along the north half (y 1662-1679, incl. a light-blue item at x 1382-1397 and white ribbed blocks), plain band along the south half, white south parapet at y 1699-1701. White parapet bar on the west end (x 1216-1220). SE corner is notched: the plain south band stops at x~1558 and there is a dark recess at x 1530-1556, y 1690-1703. IMPORTANT: imagery is oblique; roofs of these ~6-floor slabs are displaced about 41 px south and 6 px west of their bases, so the estimated ground footprint is rect [1223,1617,1572,1660] (+/-8 px), not directly visible because trees cover it. Video f_006-f_009 show its north facade: white roof parapet carrying a row of red characters (unreadable), red-brick sections with recessed balconies separated by white vertical bays, white west end bay; only the top ~3 floor rows show above the trees. EAST END: Part of the A north slab, not a separate building: bright white ribbed roof strip 87 x 21 px (24 x 5.8 m) at the east end. In the video this end of the north facade is a full-height row of slender white columns in front of glazing (about 6 column lines; satellite shows them as leaning lines at x~1490,1506,1519,1532,1544,1562, pitch ~12.5 px = 3.4 m, visible from y 1625 to 1658 north of the roof edge). Occupies roughly the east quarter of the slab length. Function not established.

items.name: Block B, south bar, rotated about 10 degrees (use not established)

height.basis: 6 floor lines counted by the measurement agent on one block's north facade in the satellite image; 3.3 m floor height assumed; estimate, +/- 4 m

items.measuredBy: measurement agent (dorms), single reading, recheck pending
items.notes: Rotated about 10 degrees anticlockwise from east-west (east end swung north): north roof edge runs y = 1952.5 - 0.1765*(x-1275), checked at x 1275, 1295, 1350, 1462. About 263 px long x 42 px deep = 72 x 11.5 m. South edge is +/-6: a dark strip (parapet shadow) lies just inside it and the parapet merges with bright pavement. East end shape (square or chamfered) uncertain, +/-6. Rooftop: white ribbed blocks around x 1385-1437, light-blue item at x 1437-1452. Its shaded north facade is visible obliquely north of the roof edge: 6 floor lines at 6.5-7 px pitch running parallel to this slab, and the white west end bay spans y 1917-1957 at x 1234-1246, giving a lean of ~41 px. Estimated ground footprint: [[1230,1920.5],[1489,1875],[1496,1916],[1237,1962]] (+/-8).

courts.confidence: 8 full courts, 4 columns by 2 rows: satellite and 2018 video agree. Court size is assumed (15 x 28 m), not measured. North, south and east edges of the paved block are inferred, only the west edge is seen.
courts.paintNote: 2018 video: dark green courts with red keys, red centre discs, red-brown divider bands, one court (north row, third from west) in bright teal with a pink-red surround, an orange round logo on the north-west court. The satellite image shows all eight green with white centre marks. The two sources were not reconciled; the video paint scheme is used.
courts.extras: Double-sided hoop stands on green steel posts back to back on the central band; chain-link fence; steel railing on the west edge; row of about six trees on the west; white slogan boards on the east edge (2018 video).
courts.measuredBy: measurement agent (courts), single reading, recheck pending
